# The Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK)

> EdUHK is a leading teacher education university in Hong Kong offering undergraduate and postgraduate programmes with a focus on sustainable development, UNESCO initiatives, and regional education leadership.

EdUHK serves as a comprehensive institutional hub for prospective students, current students, staff, and alumni. The university emphasizes teacher education, research, international collaboration, and commitment to UN Sustainable Development Goals through its UNESCO Chair in Regional Education Development and Lifelong Learning.

## Key Topics

- Teacher Education
- Academic Programmes
- UNESCO Chair
- Sustainable Development Goals
- Student Services (iCONNECT, e-SIS, iBooking)
- Admissions & Scholarships
- Research Institutes
- International Collaboration
- Campus Facilities
- Alumni Engagement

- Lifelong Learning

- Hong Kong Education

## Main Portal & Language Versions

- [The Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK)](https://www.eduhk.hk/en): EdUHK homepage: education-focused university with undergraduate and postgraduate programmes
- [香港教育大學 (教大) - Traditional Chinese](https://www.eduhk.hk/zht): EdUHK traditional Chinese homepage with academic programmes and institutional overview
- [香港教育大学 (教大) - Simplified Chinese](https://www.eduhk.hk/zhs): EdUHK simplified Chinese homepage with academic programmes and institutional overview

## Student & Academic Services

- [Prospective Students](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/prospective-students): Admissions information, scholarships, and programme details for prospective students
- [Current Students](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/current-students): Student portal with academic services, iServices (iCONNECT, e-SIS, iBooking) and campus resources
- [EdUHK Library](https://www.lib.eduhk.hk): EdUHK Library homepage with e-resources, collections, and MyLibrary portal access

## Institutional Leadership & Governance

- [About EdUHK](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/about): EdUHK institutional overview, mission, and teacher education focus in Asia Pacific
- [Vision & Mission](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/about/vision-and-mission): EdUHK vision, mission, core values and strategic direction for education and research
- [President's Welcome](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/about/president-s-welcome): President John Lee Chi-Kin's welcome message and institutional leadership perspective
- [Governance](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/about/governance): EdUHK governance structure, council leadership, and institutional management overview

## Research & Global Initiatives

- [Sustainable Development Goals](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/sdgs): EdUHK's commitment to UN Sustainable Development Goals and UNESCO Chair initiatives
- [Chair in Regional Education Development and Lifelong Learning](https://www.eduhk.hk/unescochair): UNESCO Chair programme on education development, lifelong learning and TVET capacity-building

## Staff, Alumni & Community

- [Staff](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/staff): Staff portal with internal services, HR resources, AMIS system and employee information
- [Alumni](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/alumni): Alumni network, services, donations, and engagement through EdUHK Foundation
- [Careers](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/careers): Employment opportunities and recruitment information for EdUHK positions

## Campus & Visitor Information

- [Visitors](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/visitors): Campus visitor information, directions to Tai Po Campus and transportation guide
- [Directory](https://www.eduhk.hk/en/directory): Staff directory and contact lookup for EdUHK employees and departments
